snippet.title: AcroJet (1988, MSX2, Microprose / System Soft )
snippet.description: Early flight sim by rather famous Microprose (Gunship 2000, Falcon etc), focused in aerobatics, I did a quick flight with the goal of landing the plane, which I did at 1:26 of video. There are other goals such as doing specific maneuvers such as loops and so on.
